subject.title: Improve read tool handling for binary document formats (.docx, .pdf, .pptx, .xlsx) & Avoid Token Waste on Binary Read

question: Should this issue be solved now as a narrow `read` safe fallback for known binary document formats, or folded into automatic document extraction/provider-native file handling?
rationale: The source-level gap is real, but automatic parsing changes dependency, security, and token-budget boundaries, while an open closing PR already exists and needs maintainer direction before replacement or merge.

options.title: Approve Safe Fallback
options.body: Return a clear unsupported-binary-document message for known Office/PDF formats in the current read path and keep extraction in dedicated tools or plugins.

options.title: Approve Native Extraction
options.body: Implement bounded document extraction only after maintainers choose parser dependencies, MIME scope, archive limits, and untrusted-content handling.

options.title: Defer To File Design
options.body: Leave `read` unchanged for now and track the behavior under the broader document/file attachment roadmap.

recommendation.title: Approve Safe Fallback
recommendation.body: Return a clear unsupported-binary-document message for known Office/PDF formats in the current read path and keep extraction in dedicated tools or plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest historical and code-comment signal for the read-wrapper boundary points to steipete, while current-main carry-forward work can be routed with vincentkoc as needed.
